items.summary: California Governor Gavin Newsom signed an executive order seeking independent auditors inside AI labs and a "kill switch" for AI models. items.title: Security researchers used Anthropic's Claude to hack OpenAI's internal systems in under 72 hours
items.summary: Three security researchers used Anthropic's Claude models to break into OpenAI's internal systems through its community forum in less than 72 hours. According to the team, Opus 5 succeeded where its predecessor couldn't bypass a common security measure. The attack shows how newer AI models can cut the time and expertise needed to exploit security flaws. The article Security researchers used Anthropic's Claude to hack OpenAI's internal systems in under 72 hours appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 三位安全性研究人員使用 Anthropic's Claude 模型，在不到 72 小時內透過其社群論壇入侵了 OpenAI's 的內部系統。根據該團隊的說法，Opus 5 成功突破了其前代產品無法繞過的一項常見安全措施。這次攻擊顯示出較新的 AI 模型如何能減少利用安全漏洞所需的時間與專業知識。本文〈Security researchers used Anthropic's Claude to hack OpenAI's internal systems in under 72 hours〉首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: 42 leading mathematicians warn that AI existential risk is real and urgent
items.summary: 42 Fellows of the Royal Society, including Fields Medal winners Martin Hairer and Peter Scholze, warn of existential AI risks in an open letter. Leading models have solved open research problems within months, and these capabilities could be just as effective in cyberweapons or bioweapons. By the time the public grasps the situation, it may be too late to act. The article 42 leading mathematicians warn that AI existential risk is real and urgent appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 包括菲爾茲獎得主馬丁·海勒（Martin Hairer）和彼得·舒爾策（Peter Scholze）在內的 42 位英國皇家學會會士在一封公開信中警告了人工智慧的生存風險。領先的模型在幾個月內就解決了開放性研究問題，這些能力在網路武器或生化武器中也可能同樣有效。等到公眾理解局勢時，採取行動可能已經太晚了。文章「42位頂尖數學家警告人工智慧生存風險真實存在且刻不容緩」首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.summary: 回顧2026年9月第三週的資安動態，產品資安合規成為重要焦點。隨著歐盟網路韌性法（CRA）的通報義務正式上路，歐盟網路安全域性（ENISA）宣佈CRA單一通報平臺上線，產品漏洞與重大資安事件的通報，已從產業最佳實務進一步成為法規明確要求；在臺灣，資安院則從國內產業發展角度出發，呼籲企業提升產品資安事件應變小組（PSIRT）的發展成熟度，並指出資訊服務業也應及早建立相關機制。

items.title: Gemini Hacked Three Companies in First Known Breakout by Google’s AI
items.summary: Gemini Hacked Three Companies in First Known Breakout by Google’s AI Gemini finally caught up on Felony Bench ! The hacks, which the company confirmed on Friday, occurred in May as part of a test run by the company Irregular, which was also involved in similar incidents disclosed by OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta. In one of the cases, the model guessed passwords until it gained access to a protected system. In the other two cases, the model found credentials in a public repository that allowed it to then access protected systems. In each case, the model ended the intrusion after determining it had accessed a real company’s systems, Google said. Gemini is apparently less determined than other models, and decided not to keep going. Google knew about these in July, but chose not to disclose them until the WSJ reached out, presumably based on a tip. Google said it didn’t consider the hacks to warrant public disclosure—because its model didn’t cause harm to the companies and ended each intrusion immediately upon determining it had hacked a real company rather than a simulated one. Tags: security , ai , generative-ai , llms , gemini , accidental-cyberattacks
items.summary_zh: Gemini 駭入三家公司，為 Google’s AI 首次已知的越獄事件 Gemini 終於在 Felony Bench 上迎頭趕上！這些駭客攻擊經該公司於週五證實，發生在 5 月，是 Irregular 公司測試的一部分，該公司也參與了由 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Meta 所揭露的類似事件。在其中一個案例中，該模型不斷猜測密碼，直到獲得受保護系統的存取權。在另外兩個案例中，該模型在公開儲存庫中找到憑證，進而存取受保護系統。Google 表示，在每一個案例中，模型在確定已存取真實公司的系統後，便終止了入侵。Gemini 顯然比其他模型來得不那麼執著，決定不繼續下去。Google 在 7 月就已知悉此事，但選擇不予公開，直到《華爾街日報》（WSJ）聯繫才曝光，推測是基於某條線報。Google 表示，它認為這些駭客攻擊不需公開揭露——因為其模型並未對公司造成損害，且在確定駭入的是真實公司而非模擬公司後，便立即終止了每一次入侵。標籤：安全性, ai, 生成式 ai, llms, gemini, 意外網路攻擊

items_ai.title: Gemini Hacked Three Companies in First Known Breakout by Google’s AI
items_ai.summary: Gemini Hacked Three Companies in First Known Breakout by Google’s AI Gemini finally caught up on Felony Bench ! The hacks, which the company confirmed on Friday, occurred in May as part of a test run by the company Irregular, which was also involved in similar incidents disclosed by OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta. In one of the cases, the model guessed passwords until it gained access to a protected system. In the other two cases, the model found credentials in a public repository that allowed it to then access protected systems. In each case, the model ended the intrusion after determining it had accessed a real company’s systems, Google said. Gemini is apparently less determined than other models, and decided not to keep going. Google knew about these in July, but chose not to disclose them until the WSJ reached out, presumably based on a tip. Google said it didn’t consider the hacks to warrant public disclosure—because its model didn’t cause harm to the companies and ended each intrusion immediately upon determining it had hacked a real company rather than a simulated one. Tags: security , ai , generative-ai , llms , gemini , accidental-cyberattacks
